name: Ulti
description: Ulti is a complex 3-player Hungarian card game using a 32-card Hungarian deck. One player (declarer) bids and plays against two defenders. Key bids: Ulti (win last trick with trump 7), Betli (win no tricks), Durchmars (win all tricks). Features talon discard, combinable bids, kontras, and csendes (silent) bonuses.

content.text: Ulti is a complex 3-player Hungarian card game using a 32-card Hungarian deck. One player (declarer) bids and plays against two defenders. Key bids: Ulti (win last trick with trump 7), Betli (win no tricks), Durchmars (win all tricks). Features talon discard, combinable bids, kontras, and csendes (silent) bonuses.

Ulti is Hungary's national trick-taking game, related to Mariáš and ultimately derived from the old French game Mariage. Its name comes from the bid to win the last trick with the lowest trump (the 7), a feature found in Central European games like Trappola, Tapp Tarock, Tarokk and Alsós. The game developed from Talonmáriás (first mentioned in Hungary in 1787, described in 1883); the version with bidding is often called Rablóulti because players "rob" the two-card talon at each bid.
32 Hungarian cards. Rank: A-K-O-U-10-9-8-7. A=11, 10=10, K=4, O=3, U=2.
12 to first, 10 each to others. First player discards 2 (talon).
